text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm called to the director's
office. I'm
not told why, but only that my
presence is
necessary to "help make the
URA Finale a
success."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I head inside...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer
<username>!
Just as
I thought!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Emergency... Both of you, I beg you,
help me!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? P-please calm down, Director! First
of all,
could you tell us what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Regret... Even after I made that grand

announcement and asked the media to
promote
the URA Finale...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately... The URA Finale is still
not widely
known among the general
public!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Thusly! We must find some way to
communicate
its appeal and generate
some excitement!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
We must have a race packed with
smiling fans!
That is the stage on which
all Umamusume should
shine!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I understand how you feel, Director.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'd be delighted to help you find a
solution... but
what could we do?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Excellent question! That is why I have
asked you
two exceptional trainers here!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I wish for you to participate in an event
aimed at
promoting the URA Finale and
the hardworking
Umamusume hoping to
take part in it...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The URA Finale Commemorative
Festival!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... So what will this festival consist
of?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's the thing... I was so
preoccupied with
setting it up that our
event schedule at the
moment is...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Nonexistent!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For starters, we put our heads together
and
discuss what type of event we want
to hold.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Apologies! I'm causing you so much
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... This was definitely a surprise,
but I'm not
about to give up on the
event.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek has her heart set on becoming the
first
Finale Champion.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I can't let her efforts go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the trainer of another Umamusume
who's
working equally hard, I feel much
the same.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Gratitude! Thank you, from the bottom
of my
heart! I knew you wouldn't let me
down!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To business! What do you think the
event should
entail?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If we're looking to attract
attendees,
panels done by the
Umamusume and
mini-concerts tend to
be the usual go-to's...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It is. Not to mention, this is when they
need to be
focusing on training.
choice_data_list: ウマ娘たちの負担が大きいな……
ウマ娘たちの負担が大きいね……

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Just us? Surely not...
choice_data_list: 俺たちだけで出来ることはないかな
私たちだけで出来ることはないかな

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Eureka! I have an idea!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
We want to convey just how hard our

Umamusume are working to qualify for
the URA
Finale, yes?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Then there's something that you two—indeed, only you two—can do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the festival...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Why, Trainer
<username>
and
Trainer Kiryuin! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured, today's event is going to
receive
extensive coverage in Twinkle
Monthly.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Although, if you don't mind me asking,
where are
your trainees? I was certain
they would be here...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid it's just us two today, but not
to worry.
You won't be disappointed!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Today, we want to tell you about the
racers who
are working hard to earn a
spot in the URA
Finale.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As the trainers who watch them from the

sidelines, we can share a side of the
story that
nobody—not even our
trainees—can share.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh? Why, that's...
choice_data_list: 今日は彼女たちに代わって頑張ります！

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: That's simply amazing!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
To put your hardworking trainees first,
even at
this event... Such devotion!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see... Umamusume need rest too, so
you're
working hard in their place!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Not only are you giving us an enticing,

never-before-seen glimpse at the
sweat-stained
efforts of their daily
lives...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
But it's clear that you'll do anything for
your
trainees! I can't wait to see the fan
meetups, talk
shows, and mini-concerts
you'll be doing on their
behalf!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Say no more! I will make sure our readers
fully
understand how deep your
dedication runs!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't I host? When it comes
to
warming up a crowd, I'm a
professional!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before we know it...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I hope you're watching, everyone! Next
up is our
two trainers' mini-concert! ♪

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Umapyoi! Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ah ha ha! Good luck, trainers!
choice_data_list: う、うまぴょい、うまぴょいっ！

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
They're really putting themselves in their

Umamusumes' shoes... I like their spirit!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
The URA Finale, huh? Maybe I'll check it
out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The event goes a little off-script, but we
succeed
in spreading the word about the
URA Finale.
